job.location: Work from home; candidates can live anywhere in the United States; up to 25% travel
job.rawJd: CVS Health is building a more connected, convenient, and compassionate health experience. The Account Manager manages client relationships, supports customer satisfaction, and drives customer success. Responsibilities include serving as the primary contact for operational matters; addressing client needs and resolving issues; gathering and processing complex requirements; developing practical solutions; maintaining responsive, reliable, and accurate service; answering customer feedback and escalations; advocating for customers; coordinating internal resources; tracking client issues; reporting on account status, feedback, and improvement opportunities; identifying problems before they escalate; and participating in training and knowledge sharing. The role is work from home and candidates may live anywhere in the United States. Required qualifications include 3+ years in a client or customer service environment or a previous Account Manager role; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and web-based applications; and the ability to travel up to 25%. PBM knowledge is helpful but not required. Experience with intranet and extranet systems, CRM, or adjudication platforms such as Salesforce, Peoplesafe, or AS400 is preferred. A high school diploma or GED is required and a bachelor's degree is preferred. The anticipated schedule is 40 hours per week, full time. The posted pay range is $43,888-$76,500, with possible bonus, commission, or short-term incentive eligibility. The anticipated application window closes August 14, 2026.
